description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and you begin to emit a disquieting hum until the start of your next turn; any hostile creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you takes 1d4 sonic damage.

At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 sonic damage and the hum's damage increases by 1d4; both bonuses increase again at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
